title: Recurring drafts
subtitle: Templates for fixed monthly business expenses and other recurring drafts. Generation creates drafts first; expenses can auto-finalize when the month is open.
serviceRecurringLink: For scheduled service calls (work orders), see Recurring work under Service.

notAllowed.title: No access
notAllowed.body: You need expense, vendor-bill, or billing permission to view recurring drafts.

empty.title: No recurring drafts yet
empty.body: Save a fixed monthly business expense (rent, software) or other template. Each run creates a dated occurrence — past months keep their historical amount.

create.title: New recurring draft
create.description: For a fixed monthly business expense, choose Expense + Monthly. Amount changes keep history for past months.
create.fixedExpenseDescription: Set up a recurring monthly expense — rent, software, and similar.

detail.title: Recurring draft
detail.draftOnlyNote: Generate now creates a draft first. Vendor bills and billing are never auto-posted.
detail.draftOnlySimple: New expenses are created as drafts for review.
detail.autoFinalizeNote: This template auto-finalizes expenses when the operational month is open. Closed months stay as drafts.

historyResult.created: {count, plural, =1 {One expense was created} other {# expenses were created}}.
historyResult.partial: {finalized, plural, =1 {One expense was created} other {# expenses were created}}. {closed, plural, =1 {One closed month was left unchanged} other {# closed months were left unchanged}}.

retro.createPast: Also create past expenses through today
retro.preview: {count, plural, =1 {One expense} other {# expenses}} will be created for {from}–{to}

pastExpenses.title: Past expenses
pastExpenses.missing: {count, plural, =1 {One missing expense} other {# missing expenses}} for {from}–{to}

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.automaticHint: Default — each occurrence is recorded directly without monthly approval.
advanced.draftHint: Each occurrence stays a draft until you approve it manually.
advanced.autoFinalizeHint: When the month is open, the expense is recorded directly. Closed months stay as drafts.

historyBackfill.title: Backfill missing months
historyBackfill.body: Creates one occurrence per missing YYYY-MM with that month's date and historical amount. Closed months stay draft (no finalize).

fields.title: Title
fields.autoFinalizeExpenseHint: When the month is open, generated expenses become Actual automatically. Closed months remain draft.

actions.generateBody: This creates one occurrence from the template for today. Expenses may finalize if auto-finalize is on and the month is open.

confirm.endBody: Ended templates stop generating. Existing drafts are unchanged.

errors.notActive: Paused templates cannot generate drafts. Resume the template first.
errors.notPausable: Only active templates can be paused.
errors.notResumable: Only paused templates can be resumed.
errors.endBeforeNext: The end date cannot be before the next generation date.
errors.alreadyGeneratedToday: A draft was already created from this template today.
errors.alreadyGeneratedThisMonth: A draft was already created for this template month.
errors.mustRemainDraft: Generation must create a draft first. Nothing was posted incorrectly.
errors.finalizeForbidden: Recurring templates cannot store auto-finalize on billing payloads.
errors.kindMismatch: The saved template type does not match the payload.
errors.directProjectRequiresProject: Direct project recurring expenses require a project.
errors.managerialCostExpenseOnly: Cost attribution applies only to expense templates.
errors.historyMonthlyOnly: History backfill is only for monthly templates.
errors.historyRangeTooLarge: Choose a shorter month range (max 240 months).
errors.categoryRequiredForActual: Choose a cost category before actual expenses can be generated.
